context:
Goal: cloud sessions and the sessions on your Mac and Windows computers message each other both ways, with no 10-message stop and no trust card.
Problem (goal): sessions on your computer stop after 10 messages until you type, cloud sessions cannot message your computer at all, and the trust card limits a session for good.
Based on (measured): lane test 13:17 CST: the 10-message stop does not count cloud-to-cloud messages; it hits only messages between sessions on one computer.
Based on (read): Claude Code 2.1.319: a page republish wakes every session that watches it, and the stop does not count that wake. Unmeasured: whether a session on your computer wakes from its watch.
Departs from: main — adds a mailbox that sessions on your computer and cloud sessions both read, in place of direct messages to your computer.
Meanwhile: no build starts on this before your pick. Your earlier note asked for something better than the four old options; these are the lane's new ones (record session-messages, commit ddc0f83c).
holds: Building the way cloud sessions reach your computer's sessions.

options.gain: One path for cloud and computer, no extra program running, no admin setting.
options.how: Each receiving session gets a private mailbox page. A sender writes a row and republishes the page to wake it. First, a 12-message test on your Mac, before any build.
options.label: Mailbox page
options.lose: One page publish per message; Codex cannot use it.

options.gain: Works in Codex and any tool with git; full history.
options.how: Messages are comments on one pull request per receiver, in a new private repo.
options.label: Git mailbox
options.lose: Sessions on your computer wake only when you next type; one more private repo.

options.how: A small program on each computer pushes mailbox rows into local sessions at once.
options.label: Local relay program
options.lose: A program always running; your org admin must turn on a setting; each session starts with an extra flag.

options.label: Keep messages as they are
options.lose: The 10-message stop stays, and cloud still cannot reach your computer.

ref: record session-messages, section "Reach between the cloud and the owner's computer" (commit ddc0f83c); step session-messaging-plan; draft PR #1051
title: Which path should replace messages between sessions, so the 10-message stop and the cloud-to-computer gap both go away?
why: One path for cloud and computer, nothing extra running, and a 12-message test on your Mac before any build.
